decision.rationale: This audit has not established the complete exact-material/measurement/model/deployment chain for any reviewed candidate. Separate source identities cannot be joined by analogy; profile remains unchanged.

assessment.biological_context: Human primary CD4/CD8 ex-vivo engineered cells; nuclear response and surface-antigen contact; mouse recipients remain mouse.
assessment.reuse_terms: Copyright and deposit terms unresolved for source freeze; no policy accepted.
assessment.material_correspondence: Resource names are leads; empty response backbone cannot establish measured payload identity.

assessment.available_model: No matched executable secretion model established in inspected main text/supplement.

candidates.name: Zhang 2015 inducible IL-12 TIL clinical boundary

assessment.exact_sequence: Complete versioned nucleotide files not retrieved.
assessment.complete_molecule: Engineered cell product differs from a complete RNA specification delivered for in-vivo engineering.
assessment.quantitative_measurements: Partial primary-text inspection identifies concentrations, serial serum observations and adverse outcomes; no instantaneous per-cell rate or cue-off trajectory.
assessment.available_model: No matched executable model or independent evaluation partition established by partial review.
assessment.biological_context: Patients receiving autologous ex-vivo engineered TILs; not in-vivo RNA engineering or a general human population.
assessment.reuse_terms: AACR copyright; complete-source/redistribution review open; no patient-level records retained.
assessment.material_correspondence: Construct-to-lot-to-observation chain not independently reconciled; does not validate a different product.

assessment.exact_sequence: Six selected/reserve version-specific sequences rechecked; all twenty deposited GenBank records retained in historical bundle.
assessment.complete_molecule: Complete deposited circular DNA records; experimental preparation, companion material and chemistry not fully reconciled.
assessment.quantitative_measurements: 57 processed fluorescence/CV summary rows in two Figure 4 ranges; not secretion, raw single-cell data or independent evaluation cases.

assessment.biological_context: Flp-In 293, source alias HEK293, CVCL_U421; not primary T cells or patient deployment.

assessment.material_correspondence: Study/accession/construct-label correspondence; feature-to-model and manufactured-material correspondence unestablished.

assessment.available_model: No matched predictive model/parameter uncertainty/evaluation package established in inspected disclosure.

assessment.material_correspondence: RM_61461-to-SEQ151/formulation labels are a source chain, not frozen exact sequence/chemistry/lot identity.

gaps.evidence_required: Versioned full record; all regions, topology/chemistry, independent boundary review; separate template, mature molecule and preparation.
Exact construct/variant-to-measured preparation links; retain unresolved joins.
Matched units/readouts, sampling/cell-time information and uncertainty; justified observation model.
Applicable activation, inactivity, persistence, recovery, healthy, input-loss and shutdown observations/actuation.
Exact recipient state/population, modality, delivery/exposure, destination and unintended recipients.
Versioned matched model, parameter provenance, independently justified evaluation partition.
Permitted source bytes, source corrections and material-specific access/reuse review.
Matched donor/cell-state/measurement variability and limits for each proposed claim.

evaluation.reason: No complete matched model/material/observation set selected. Inspected figures and prior fits are not a held-out partition.

retention_scope: Small audit records/metadata only. Original full papers, sequences, models and measurement bundles are not included; offline integrity does not reconstruct biology.
